item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00273","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C02","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.9,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a material template because it uses the same International Organizations Immunities Act machinery, the distinctive formula designating organizations as entitled to “privileges, exemptions, and immunities,” and expressly identifies the three earlier orders that the child revokes. Its plural-organizations framing is closer to the child than C02. C02 is also strong but concerns a single organization. C18 shares a revocation structure, but its subject and administrative machinery are unrelated.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the United Nations Relief and Rehabilitation Administration, the Inter-American Coffee Board, and the Intergovernmental Committee on refugees were designated ... as public international organizations entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the International Organizations Immunities Act","parent_excerpt":"I hereby designate such organizations as public international organizations entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act","explanation":"This is distinctive, substantially identical statutory designation language, adapted from conferring status to reciting and revoking it."},{"child_excerpt":"designated, respectively, by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of February 19, 1946 [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of July 11, 1946, and [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of January 24, 1947","parent_excerpt":"This order supplements [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of February 19, 1946, 9751 of July 11, 1946, 9823 of January 24, 1947 ...","explanation":"C09 reproduces the same series of predecessor directives, including precisely the three orders targeted by the child, showing continuity in the same legal-administrative chain."}]}
